items.description: Fix BarrelList indexing and insertion at boundaries to match built-in list behavior, including after data has split across internal sublists.
items.hypothesis: BarrelList's __getitem__ and insert methods mishandle boundary indexes (0, -1, len) when the internal structure has multiple sublists or empty sublists.
items.next_action: Inspect BarrelList's __getitem__ and insert methods in boltons/listutils.py to locate the boundary indexing bug.

items.description: Ensure BarrelList.pop() works correctly when there are empty tail sublists.
items.hypothesis: BarrelList.pop() fails to skip empty sublists at the end, causing IndexError or incorrect behavior.
items.next_action: Inspect BarrelList.pop() implementation for handling of empty tail sublists.

items.description: Fix IndexedSet to preserve ordering and indexes after bulk difference and intersection updates.
items.hypothesis: IndexedSet's difference_update and intersection_update methods corrupt the index mapping when removing multiple elements.
items.next_action: Inspect IndexedSet's difference_update and intersection_update methods in boltons/setutils.py.

items.description: Prevent IndexedSet large removals from triggering repeated full compactions.
items.hypothesis: IndexedSet's removal logic triggers a full index rebuild on every removed element instead of batching the compaction.
items.next_action: Inspect the removal/compaction logic in IndexedSet for repeated full index rebuilds.
